categories.main_business_segments: Ledman Optoelectronic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the LED downstream application sector, focusing on LED ultra-high-definition displays and LED lighting. Their product portfolio includes COB-based Micro LED ultra-high-definition display products, smart conference interactive display systems, smart classroom educational interactive display systems, ultra-high-definition home giant screens, LED creative displays, and LED smart lighting. The company also engages in LED display and lighting manufacturing and sales through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced LED technologies such as COB (Chip On Board) integrated packaging, MIP (Micro LED in Package), and COG (Chip On Glass) glass-based Micro LED display technologies. They emphasize intelligent manufacturing, digital supply chain management, and AI integration to enhance product quality and reduce costs. Production is carried out in large-scale manufacturing bases in Guangdong, Shenzhen, and overseas facilities in Vietnam, employing order-based and stock production models with strict supplier qualification and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ledman serves a diverse customer base across commercial, educational, governmental, and residential sectors. Key markets include emergency response, security, monitoring, education, command and dispatch, data centers, conferences, exhibitions, and home entertainment. The company has a strong presence in international markets, including North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and emerging markets in Africa and Latin America, with over 100 countries covered.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with manufacturing and sales facilities in Shenzhen, Huizhou, Guangzhou, and overseas in Vietnam. Its international sales network spans over 100 countries, with significant revenue contributions from North America, Europe, Asia (excluding China), and other regions such as the Middle East and South America. The company maintains overseas operational centers in Japan, the USA, the Netherlands, and Dubai to support localized services and market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ledman operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the LED supply chain. It focuses on LED packaging, display screen manufacturing, and lighting product assembly, integrating upstream LED chip technologies through partnerships but mainly producing finished LED display and lighting products. The company controls its supply chain from LED device packaging to application product manufacturing and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in Micro LED display technologies, including COB, MIP, and COG, aiming to reduce costs and expand application scenarios. It invests heavily in R&D for ultra-high-definition displays, AI-enabled smart interaction, and energy-efficient LED lighting solutions. Strategic initiatives include expanding global market penetration, enhancing intelligent manufacturing capabilities, and fostering industry collaboration to accelerate Micro LED commercialization and 8K ultra-high-definition product development.
categories.revenue_model: Ledman generates revenue primarily through the sale of LED display screens and LED lighting products. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels, with a significant portion of revenue derived from international exports. The company also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies related to technology development and energy efficiency projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Shenzhen Absen Optoelectronic Co., Ltd., Shenzhen Unilumin Group Co., Ltd., Leyard Optoelectronic Co., Ltd., Shenzhen AOTO Electronics Co., Ltd., and Shenzhen Lianyu Optoelectronics Co., Ltd. Ledman positions itself as a global leader in Micro LED ultra-high-definition displays and COB technology, recognized as a pioneer in advanced LED packaging and smart display solutions with a strong brand presence and strategic partnerships, including with China's aerospace sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Ledman reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.25 billion, representing a 12.5% year-over-year increase, driven mainly by a 22.1% growth in overseas business. Despite revenue growth, the company experienced a net loss attributable to increased expenses from asset impairments, goodwill and inventory write-downs, and higher R&D and marketing investments. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 1.73 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of approximately RMB 888 million, with ongoing efforts to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ledman emphasizes its technological leadership in COB-based Micro LED ultra-high-definition displays, offering products with superior image quality, energy efficiency, and innovative AI-enabled interactive features. Its unique value lies in comprehensive product ecosystems covering commercial, educational, and residential applications, combined with intelligent manufacturing and global localized service networks. The company’s energy-saving COB 'Leiming' series and award-winning design further differentiate its offerings in competitive markets.
